# Timedoor Academy

> > Global kids coding academy offering game development, robotics, AI, and web development courses across 20+ countries with 10,000+ students and 300+ teachers.

Timedoor Academy is a Japanese-Indonesian IT education organization providing both online and offline coding courses for children and teens. The academy offers specialized tracks from beginner robotics to advanced AI engineering, with physical branches across Asia and the Middle East, plus a professional bootcamp program (Timedoor Academy Pro) for aspiring developers.

## Key Topics

- Game Development
- Kids Coding Courses
- Python Programming
- JavaScript
- Robotics & IoT
- AI & Machine Learning
- Computer Vision
- Web Development
- Mobile App Development
- Online/Offline Learning
- Timedoor Academy Pro
- Coding for Kids (Ages 5-17)
- Regional Offices (Indonesia, Malaysia, Egypt, Philippines)
- Franchise Partnerships
- Coding Education

## Core Courses

- [Junior Coder](https://timedooracademy.com/course/junior-coder): Fun coding course for ages 5-7: robotics, animations, 3D games, AR/VR projects
- [Code Adventure](https://timedooracademy.com/course/code-adventure): Game design and coding course for ages 8-14: Roblox, Lua, mobile apps, programming fundamentals
- [Python Developer](https://timedooracademy.com/course/python-developer): Python course for ages 9+: AI, computer vision, game development
- [IoT Developer](https://timedooracademy.com/course/iot-developer): Robotics and smart technology course for ages 10-15: Arduino, smart city projects
- [Software Developer](https://timedooracademy.com/course/software-developer): Web and mobile development course: JavaScript, React Native, full-stack apps
- [AI Engineer](https://timedooracademy.com/course/ai-engineer): AI and machine learning course: Python, computer vision, data science for kids and teens

## Professional Programs

- [Timedoor Academy Pro](https://pro.timedooracademy.com): 3-month mentored coding bootcamp: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Vue.js for aspiring developers
